title: Prediction-market-derived surface comparison (fixture)
research_question: How does a binary-threshold-derived surface compare with a matched listed European-options surface?
example_notice: Illustrative schema fixture only; values are not findings or a current market snapshot.

contract_scope.description: Terminal close-above-threshold contracts on one underlying and expiry.

data_coverage.coverage_summary: One illustrative threshold and one aligned listed-options surface point.
known_gaps: No full strike ladder or surface history is represented.

method.summary: Convert terminal binary thresholds to digital bounds, reconstruct synthetic calls, then invert European Black–Scholes.
method.benchmark: Contemporaneous listed European-options surface on the same underlying and expiry

metrics.name: pm_bs_equivalent_iv
metrics.definition: Model-transformed volatility from illustrative binary prices.

uncertainty.summary: Illustrative quote and reconstruction uncertainty only.
items: Tail, interpolation, and quote-quality sensitivity are not estimated in this fixture.

limitations: A prediction-market-derived Black–Scholes-equivalent IV is not a listed option quote or proof of mispricing.

surface_points.quote_uncertainty: Illustrative; bid/ask and reconstruction bounds not calculated.

reconstruction_assumptions: Illustrative discounting and tail assumptions only.
